+"""Header helper."""
+
+def api_key_header(value: str | None) -> str:
+    if not value:
+        return ""
+    v = value.strip()
+    if v.lower().startswith("apikey "):
+        return "ApiKey " + v[7:].strip()
+    return f"ApiKey {v}"
